test_launch_consumer_steps: test the launch_test module by running the consumer_producers program with 2 producers and verifying 10 consumer steps
build_lp_program: build a launchpad program with make_program that creates producer and consumer nodes
run_lp_launch: run lp.launch with test_mt launch type to execute the consumer_producers program in a test environment
create_node_handle: create a courier handle from a node and dereference it to obtain a client for remote method calls
disable_node_run: disable automatic run() execution on a consumer node before launching for manual step control
